title: Digital Nomad Lifestyle: Pros, Cons, and a Realistic Test
seo_title: Digital Nomad Lifestyle: Pros, Cons and Reality
meta_description: Explore the real pros and cons of the digital nomad lifestyle: visas, tax, time zones, costs, loneliness and a practical 30-day readiness test.
excerpt: The digital nomad lifestyle can offer autonomy and travel, but it also adds legal, financial and social work. Use this framework to decide whether it fits you.
